instructions: Replace every source identity from read-only metadata; freeze and hash the reviewed plan.
infra/restore-drill.ps1 -PlanPath <plan> -ReceiptDirectory <new private folder> performs read-only preflight.
Add -ExecuteRestore only after reviewing the exact source and isolated target. Never retry an uncertain operation or reuse a journal folder.
The restore runner reads metadata only. documentReadsUpper records the separate validation budget; it does not perform or enforce the later document scan.
Completion requires separate named-database count/ID/hash, deleted-account, relationship and canonical-source validation. Restore completion alone is not recovery proof.
Firebase Auth, Storage, TTL, rules, IAM and application configuration require their own recovery plan. Never reenable historical deleted/disabled users.
Cleanup requires a separate exact target UID/etag review and approval after receipts are saved. This runner never deletes databases.
